module: MCP "world" tools: list and load levels, trigger a bound input action (like a key press), recover or delete a vehicle, and query the ground (height, grip/drivability) at a point.
notes: Inconsistency: list_levels returns the key `file` for each level, whereas the schema description announces `[{name, title, path}]`.
load_level is disruptive (reloads the world). It looks up the level by levelName in core_levels.getList(), otherwise by path.getPathLevelMain(name).
trigger_action uses core_input_actions.triggerDown/triggerUp/triggerDownUp; without state it is a brief press.

list_levels.desc: Lists the installed levels: name (levelName), title, file (fullfilename or misFilePath).

load_level.desc: Loads a level (core_levels.startLevel) by path or by name.

trigger_action.desc: Triggers a game input action by its name (e.g. recover_vehicle, toggleCamera, switch_next_vehicle).

recover_vehicle.desc: Puts the vehicle back on the last road and repairs it (spawn.teleportToLastRoad with resetVehicle).

returns.desc: true if the vehicle does not exist.

get_ground_at_point.desc: Surface height under a point (be:getSurfaceHeightBelow) and terrain drivability (be:getTerrainDrivability) within a radius.

args.desc: {pos?: {x,y,z} (default player vehicle position), radius?: number m (default 2)}
